note: Upstream skills fill the stages where the community already did the work well. Each entry says which stage it serves and why it was picked over the alternatives in the library. Attribution stays with the author.

skills.name: move-gtm-diagnostic
skills.author: sangram-vajre
skills.why: Run before any build: the 4-question MOVE audit tells you whether the company is at problem-market, product-market or platform-market fit, which decides how aggressive the channel can be.

skills.name: market-finder
skills.author: uri-knorovich
skills.why: Enumerates every business of a type in a geography from directories and registries, with a coverage audit. The account universe for the chosen country.

skills.name: icp-matrix-builder
skills.author: tanyo-gochev
skills.why: Turns the ICP into a scored decision rule the list build can be filtered against, instead of a paragraph nobody applies.

skills.name: competitor-positioning
skills.author: alon-goldenberg
skills.why: Messaging matrix and white-space map of the local competitors, with battlecard inputs. Feeds the positioning of the entry message.

skills.name: battlecard
skills.author: ido-goldberg
skills.why: Compact battlecard format (win conditions, objections, talk tracks) that the demo-booking call reuses.

skills.name: ai-pricing-model-picker
skills.author: manny-medina
skills.why: For AI-agent products: per agent, per action, per workflow or per outcome, with anchors. Pricing is kept out of cold outreach but must exist before the first demo.

skills.name: tam-builder
skills.author: tanyo-gochev
skills.why: Company universe deduplicated to one row per company with size band, geography and fit class, plus an honest coverage report. Companies only; people come next.

skills.name: list-architect
skills.author: alex-vacca
skills.why: The reference on sourcing, boolean search, qualification, contact finding and deduplication, with 19 reference pages. Used for the mechanics once the authority model has said who to look for.

skills.name: signal-sourcer
skills.author: alex-vacca
skills.why: Buying-signal taxonomy and signal-to-play mapping (hiring, funding, job change, tech change). Supplies the Intent dimension of the scoring rubric.

skills.name: hygiene-gated-outbound
skills.author: ryan-iyengar
skills.why: Launch-readiness gate on duplicates, ownership gaps and stale data before any segment goes out. Protects the single-source-of-truth invariant.

skills.name: never-guess-an-email
skills.author: lucas-godtfredsen
skills.why: Routing decision when no verified address exists: send, other channel, or unreachable and say so. Pattern-guessing is banned in this engine.

skills.name: cold-email-strategist
skills.author: alex-vacca
skills.why: Deliverability, domain warm-up, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, sequence structure and copy frameworks, 25 reference pages. The infrastructure layer under every sequence.

skills.name: multichannel-campaign-builder
skills.author: erwann-lefevre
skills.why: Writes the full email plus social sequence from three candidate angles and self-checks against a copy bar. Takes the group template from segment-then-write and produces every touch.

skills.name: cold-email-preflight
skills.author: imad-badreddine
skills.why: Pre-send checklist on copy, links, merge fields and infrastructure. Nothing goes out without it.

skills.name: trigger-based-outbound
skills.author: ryan-iyengar
skills.why: Qualifies a single detected account event into send, nurture or skip, with a trigger-grounded opener. Used for signal-driven sends outside the resource-magnet flow.

skills.name: handle-reply
skills.author: ido-goldberg
skills.why: Classifies inbound replies and drafts the response or stop action without auto-sending. Pairs with the six-category reply table in zero-lead-lost.

skills.name: pre-call-script
skills.author: dyanesh-perumal
skills.why: Builds the call from the account's research: opener, KPI-tied relevance frame, proof point, one ask, the two or three objections this prospect will raise. Complements demo-booking-call for cold dials.

skills.name: discovery-to-demo-bridge
skills.author: gal-aga
skills.why: Turns discovery notes into a demo that proves value instead of a feature tour. The step right after the booked demo.

skills.name: meddpicc-gap-audit
skills.author: amit-rotstein
skills.why: Scores what is actually missing on a deal from transcripts and threads. The qualification backbone for long-cycle robotics and enterprise AI deals.

skills.name: multi-thread-deals
skills.author: ido-goldberg
skills.why: Finds single-threaded deals, names the missing stakeholders and hands contact-specific next steps back to outreach.

skills.name: trial-poc-conversion
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: Trials and pilots that end in a decision: success criteria contracted before access, activation instrumented, conversion clock. Essential for robots on the floor and agents in production.

skills.name: roi-business-case
skills.author: gal-aga
skills.why: A business case the buyer's finance team believes, with ranges instead of one dream number. Uses the per-unit cost numbers from the battlecard.

skills.name: mutual-action-plan-builder
skills.author: gal-aga
skills.why: Buyer-evidence milestones co-owned by the buying committee, not seller activities. The instrument for security review, procurement and works-council steps.

skills.name: procurement-navigation
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: Security review, legal redlines and vendor onboarding run in parallel on a mutual close plan. The compliance pack from regulatory-to-selling-points is what it ships.

skills.name: onboarding-activation
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: Carries the why-they-bought evidence across signature to first realised value on a clock. Where the first European reference is made.

skills.name: win-loss-program
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: Evidence-based win/loss from transcripts and buyer interviews. Its output feeds the monthly ICP and battlecard refresh in the operating cadence.

skills.name: partner-channel-operations
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: Partner programme, enablement, co-selling and deal registration. Activated when the entry-mode selector chose an integrator or distributor route.

skills.name: expansion-revenue-architect
skills.author: rutger-katz
skills.why: NRR/GRR diagnostic and expansion motion once the first accounts are live. The right side of the funnel the channel eventually feeds.
